assertions.assertion: SilverBridge denied CPT 93229 Mobile Cardiac Telemetry
The service is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
Such diagnostic monitoring services require pre-approval to ensure medical necessity and coverage eligibility
The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation
A mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity
